9. SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONAL STRATEGIES (if any) i. This subject has theory component that is taught during practical classes so as to develop and encourage subject related skills. For this each student needs to be attended to, by the concerned faculty individually and hence this subject should be treated as a “studio” subject. ii. Students should be allowed to work independently and use their creativity to the maximum. Faculty should guide students only when they ask help.
